tiktok.author: peter_nina
tiktok.body:
I wish I had these apps on my first time in Japan, would have made travelling so much easier!  Save this for your Japan trip or share it with someone coming to Japan 🙇‍♂️
Three apps you need before coming to Japan. I live in Tokyo and I still use these. First is Gomi Navi Japan. Everyone knows it's impossible to find a trash can in Japan. So this app has actually saved me so many times. Everybody seen those memes of people carrying their trash around Japan and with this app, you won't be that guy. Next is Kuli Kuli, a translation app that actually works because ordering when the menu looks like this makes my heart drop. It not only translate the text, but it highlights each menu item and gives you a picture so you actually know what you're ordering. I have allergies so it's super helpful to have that back to back voice translation. It translates back to you so you know you aren't missing something in translation. Lastly is Nerve. Japan gets a lot of earthquakes and the first time your phone goes off, it's honestly quite scary. Nerve sends an alert to you as soon as one happens so you know exactly what's going on. Pretty much every Japanese person I know has this on their phone. Honestly, it's better to cancel a day trip during a typhoon than get stuck in the middle of it. So save this video for your Japan trip and make sure to download those apps. Follow for more.
